backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the TrustFix backend with data types and CRUD operations for bookings and reviews, including approval, filtering by service/rating, and featured review retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing two required features: creating the FloatingCallButton component and integrating it into Layout.tsx alongside the existing FloatingWhatsAppButton without visual conflicts.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of all frontend source files to short summaries describing each component's or page's purpose and key implementation details.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme design tokens (colors, radius, chart, sidebar variables).
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the TrustFix React SPA with cache-control meta tags and a root div mounting point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router with six routes (Home, Services, Pricing, Booking, Contact, Reviews) wrapped in a Layout component and a scroll-to-top effect on navigation.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedReviewsC: Displays up to six approved reviews in a looping shadcn Carousel with avatar initials, star ratings, and skeleton loading states.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: Fixed circular call button positioned at the middle-left of the screen with green background, phone icon, tooltip, hover scale effect, and long-press (500ms) support for triggering a tel: call.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Fixed bottom-right floating button linking to WhatsApp with a pulse animation, notification dot, and the official WhatsApp green brand color.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with contact info, quick navigation links, social media icons, and a service availability banner for TrustFix.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Displays a full-screen hero section with a background image, headline, and a 'Book Now' button linking to the booking page.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Wraps page content with Navbar, Footer, floating WhatsApp/call buttons, and a subtle logo watermark background.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky navigation bar with logo, desktop/mobile nav links, and a live service search input with a dropdown results panel.
frontend/src/components/PricingCard.tsx: Card component displaying a service's name, category, description, starting price, and a 'Book Service' button linking to the booking page.
frontend/src/components/ReviewCard.tsx: Card component that renders a customer review with avatar, name, service, star rating, review text, and formatted date.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Card component showing a service image, category badge, name, description, starting price, and a 'Book Now' button with image fallback handling.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCategoryG: Responsive grid of eight service category cards with images, icons, and intersection-observer-driven scroll animations linking to the services page.
frontend/src/components/StarRating.tsx: Reusable star rating component that supports both interactive selection and read-only display modes.
frontend/src/components/SuccessPopup.tsx: Modal popup displaying a success message with a check icon that auto-closes after 5 seconds or on manual dismiss.
A form component that collects user review data (name, service, star rating, text, optional photo) and submits it via the useReviewSubmission hook, showing a success popup on completion.
frontend/src/data/services.ts: Static data file exporting a categorized record of services (e.g., Pest Control, Carpentry), each with id, name, description, price, and image path.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
Custom hook that submits a booking form to the ICP backend actor and opens a prefilled WhatsApp message, managing submitting/success state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports React Query hooks for fetching approved reviews (across all service types) and all bookings from the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useReviewSubmission.t: Custom hook that submits a review (including optional photo as a blob) to the ICP backend actor and invalidates the reviews query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchServices.ts: Custom hook that debounces a search query and filters the static services data by name, category, or description, returning matching results.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, defines TrustFix brand CSS custom properties for light/dark modes, and provides utility classes for glassmorphism effects and custom animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Booking.tsx: Booking page with a form for users to submit service requests (name, phone, email, service, address, message), pre-populating the service field from URL search params and showing a success popup on submission.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page displaying TrustFix contact details (phone, email, location, WhatsApp link), an embedded Google Map, and a simple contact form with an alert on submission.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page composing the HeroSection, a services grid, and a customer reviews carousel, with an IntersectionObserver to trigger scroll-based animations on sections.
frontend/src/pages/Pricing.tsx: Pricing page that renders all services grouped by category using PricingCard components, with a disclaimer alert that final prices depend on inspection.
frontend/src/pages/Reviews.tsx: Reviews page that fetches and displays approved customer reviews with category filtering, shows an average rating summary, loading skeletons, and includes a WriteReviewForm component.
frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx: Services page with tabbed category filtering that reads initial category and serviceId from URL search params, scrolls to and highlights a specific service card when a serviceId is provided.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the TrustFix frontend, extending the default theme with custom colors (using oklch variables), border radii, box shadows, keyframe animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks the TrustFix project state at version 3, documenting two existing features (FloatingCallButton component creation and its integration into Layout.tsx) and one pending architectural request for a floating left-side green call button linked to tel:8884447229.
